name: Moon Jellies
description: Moon jellyfish pulsing slowly up through still water, glowing at night and painted like watercolour by day.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of jellies, spread over three depths. Far ones are smaller, fainter and slower. Up to 16.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colours the bells are tinted with, most common first. Each jelly blends one with the next. Any CSS colours or tokens.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for time: the pulse, the swimming, the current and the falling marine snow.

props.name: interactive
props.description: When true, jellies near the pointer turn away and take an extra pulse, and pressing the water outside links, buttons and fields sends out a pressure ring that stirs the tentacles.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the sizes, colours and starting places of the jellies. The same seed gives the same water.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the water. The component paints no background; place it on a dark surface for the night look. Other div props are passed through.
